fusions.name: Rearing Palms
fusions.desc: You rear up and bring both palms down, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Giddy-Up Slap
fusions.desc: A smart slap that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds. For 3 seconds after using it, you move 15% faster.

fusions.name: Cantering Vault
fusions.desc: You vault off one hand and carry 5 tiles forward at a gallop. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Gallop in the Veins
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
